pages.title: Method
pages.content:
( 02 )

Method

Our relocation method moves your entire office over a single weekend.

Labelled before it is lifted.

METHOD

( 01 )

Survey

Phase 1: Survey (Week −6)

Six weeks before the move, co-founder Samir Haddad conducts a free walk-through survey of both your current and destination offices. Samir measures doorways, corridors, and freight lifts, notes power points, and photographs access routes. We identify potential bottlenecks early, agree on working constraints with building managers, and establish the complete scope of your relocation. Every project begins with this thorough physical assessment so there are no unexpected delays or logistical surprises when the move weekend arrives.

( 02 )

Plan & label

Phase 2: Plan and Label (Week −3)

Three weeks prior to moving, Samir prepares a comprehensive destination floor plan. Every functional team is assigned a distinct colour zone, and every workstation receives an individual desk number. We supply pre-printed colour-coded labels and tagged cable bags corresponding directly to the new layout. Because each crate, screen, chair, and cable bundle receives the destination desk number before leaving your current premises, our crew can position every item directly at its new location without guesswork or sorting delays.

( 03 )

Pack

Phase 3: Pack (10 Working Days Before)

Ten working days before move weekend, Tom Verbeke delivers reusable grey plastic moving crates measuring 60 × 40 × 35 cm from our Antwerp depot. Rental is included for three weeks. Staff pack their personal belongings, stationery, and desktop files, averaging six crates per desk. Meanwhile, our professional crew packs communal areas, shared storage units, file archives, and meeting rooms. Reusable cable bags are provided for keyboards, mice, and power supplies to ensure all workstation accessories remain organized.

Saturday, 09:40. Cable bags are tagged with the destination desk; IT reconnects them in order on Sunday.

( 04 )

The weekend

Phase 4: The Weekend (61 Hours)

Our relocation window runs from Friday 18:00 to Monday 07:00, spanning 61 continuous hours. On Friday at 18:00, Kwame Mensah leads the team to protect building surfaces and begin loading. By Saturday at 07:00, the old floor is emptied and crates are arranged at the destination. On Sunday, Ana Ribeiro leads furniture reassembly while Joanna Kowalczyk reconnects workstation IT by 12:00. At 20:00 on Sunday, we conduct a joint walk-through with you before returning the building keys at 07:00 on Monday.

( 05 )

Monday

Phase 5: Monday

When your staff arrive on Monday morning, two crew members remain on site from 07:00 to 12:00 to assist with unpacking, adjust monitor arms, and resolve minor layout changes. Staff unpack their crates throughout the working week at their own pace. Once all items are unpacked, Tom Verbeke arranges the collection of empty crates from your new premises within the included three-week rental window, ensuring a calm, settled transition for your organization.

( 06 )

Labels

What staff do, what the crew does

Staff pack their own desk and attach the printed destination label to each crate lid. The crew packs shared areas, moves everything, rebuilds the furniture and reconnects the IT.

One colour zone belongs to one team and one number to one desk. A crate with the right colour and number goes to the right place without anyone having to ask.

( 07 )

Request a quote

Every move starts with a free survey and ends with a fixed written quote.

Request a quote

pages.title: Prices
pages.content:
( 05 )

Prices

We provide transparent, fixed relocation prices based on workstation counts and your floor plan.

Fixed after the survey.

PRICES

( 01 )

The rates

Relocation Rates and Packages

Our commercial moving packages are structured by office size and include our complete planning process. A site survey and labelled floor plan is included at no additional cost for every client. A small office move of up to 15 desks starts from €3,900. An office move covering 16 to 40 desks starts from €8,600. A larger floor move of 41 to 90 desks starts from €17,500. All prices are in EUR, excl. 21% VAT.

All prices in EUR, excl. 21% VAT. Every move starts with a free survey.

( 02 )

Add-ons

Specialist Support and Technical Add-ons

To support technical relocations, IT disconnect and reconnect is available at €38 per workstation. Under the direction of Joanna Kowalczyk, monitors, docking stations, and peripherals are tagged, bagged, reassembled, and connected to matching desk numbers. For offices requiring specialized furniture adjustments or custom reconfiguration, an extra reassembly crew is available at €65 per crew hour. Secure document and hardware disposal is provided at €140 per locked cage, ensuring confidential disposal before or during the relocation.

( 03 )

Your quote

What Influences Your Final Quote

Following our free site survey walk-through with Samir Haddad, we issue a clear, binding quote. While our baseline pricing covers typical office setups, specific site variables may influence final cost. Factors include the availability of dedicated freight lifts versus stairs, walking distance between loading bays and offices, transit distances within our 150 km operating zone around Antwerp, and specific building management rules that dictate restricted loading hours or extra security measures during the weekend.

( 04 )

Payment

Payment Terms and Cancellation Terms

To secure your scheduled relocation weekend, a 30% deposit is payable upon booking confirmation. The remaining balance is invoiced upon project completion, payable within 14 days after the move weekend. If your corporate scheduling requirements change, you may reschedule or cancel your booked move weekend without any penalty up until 10 working days prior to the move date. This clear framework allows organizations to plan their budgets and transitions with confidence.

( 05 )

Request a quote

Every move starts with a free survey and ends with a fixed written quote.

pages.title: Moves
pages.content:
( 04 )

Moves

We specialize in corporate office relocations within 150 km of Antwerp.

Told plainly.

MOVES

( 01 )

Three moves

We specialize in corporate office relocations within 150 km of Antwerp. Explore three case stories illustrating how our 61-hour weekend window delivers calm, seamless transitions.

Forty-Two Desks, Two Floors Down

Ghent · 42 desks · Fri 18:00 → Sun 16:40

In Ghent, an expanding architecture studio needed to move forty-two desks from a split-level office into a single consolidated floor. The move commenced on Friday at 18:00 and finished on Sunday at 16:40. Studio manager Hanne De Smet noted that having every drawing table and cable bundle labelled to match the new floor plan meant her architects walked straight in on Monday morning without missing client deadlines. The entire studio was operational well ahead of Monday morning.

Read the story

The Law Office That Never Closed

Brussels · 26 desks · 310 archive crates

A commercial law firm in Brussels required relocating 26 partner and associate workstations along with extensive legal case files over a single weekend. Tom Verbeke supplied 310 archive crates fitted with individual tamper seals, each verified against a signed chain-of-custody inventory. The firm maintained continuous client confidentiality throughout packing, loading, and placement. By Sunday afternoon, all 310 archive crates were positioned beside the appropriate desks in the new Brussels office without any loss of billable hours.

Benches, a Rack and a Cold Room

Mechelen · 64 desks · rack back up Sun 11:30

A biotechnology firm in Mechelen required moving 64 desks, specialized laboratory benches, and a small server rack. Operating within tight technical parameters, Joanna Kowalczyk supervised the server rack power-down on Saturday at 08:00. The rack was transported in a padded enclosure, reinstalled, cabled, and powered back up by Sunday at 11:30. Workstations and laboratory benches were rebuilt and aligned before Sunday evening, allowing research staff to resume experiments promptly on Monday morning.

( 02 )

pages.title: Planning guide
pages.content:
( 03 )

Planning guide

Careful preparation transforms an office relocation into a predictable, calm weekend project.

Six weeks, one weekend.

PLANNING

( 01 )

Week −6

Week −6: Walk-Through and Scope

Six weeks before your target weekend, Samir Haddad visits your current and destination offices for a comprehensive site survey. We measure lift interiors, doorways, and stairwells, note loading bay restrictions, and photograph access paths. Our team evaluates your desk count, filing archives, and IT requirements. Following this visit, we issue your fixed-price quote and reserve your 61-hour weekend window, running from Friday 18:00 through Monday 07:00, within our 150 km operating area.

( 02 )

Week −3

Week −3: Layouts and Colour Coding

Three weeks out, Samir finalizes the destination floor plan. We assign each department a colour zone and give every workstation a unique destination number. We provide your move coordinator with pre-printed labels, cable tags, and packing guidelines. Reviewing these layouts with department heads ensures everyone understands where their teams sit. Every crate and accessory bag will be tagged with its corresponding desk number, preventing misplacement during the weekend transfer.

Samir measures every doorway at the survey; the floor plan you approve three weeks out is the one the crew works from.

( 03 )

Packing

Week −2 and Week −1: Crate Delivery and Packing

Ten working days before the move, Tom Verbeke delivers reusable plastic crates measuring 60 × 40 × 35 cm, with three weeks of rental included. We allocate an average of six crates per desk. Staff pack their personal items, stationery, and active files, applying pre-printed destination labels to the crate lids. We also distribute clear cable bags so employees can pack their keyboards, mice, and power leads directly from their workstations.

( 04 )

Move week

Move Week and After the Move

On Friday at 18:00, Kwame Mensah, Ana Ribeiro, and Joanna Kowalczyk begin loading, assembly, and IT reconnection. After a joint walk-through on Sunday at 20:00, keys are returned by Monday 07:00. Two crew members remain on site from 07:00 to 12:00 on Monday to assist your staff with unpacking and adjustments. Tom Verbeke collects all empty crates within the three-week rental period once your team has settled.

( 05 )

Checklist

Print this list

Pin it where the move coordinator can see it.

  • Week −6: walk-through done, scope and weekend window agreed.
  • Week −3: floor plan reviewed with department heads; colour zones and desk numbers confirmed.
  • 10 working days before: crates delivered; every desk gets about 6 crates, labels and cable bags.
  • Move week: staff finish packing; keys, lift bookings and building rules confirmed.
  • Friday 18:00: the crew arrives. Monday 07:00: keys back, two crew on site until 12:00.

( 06 )

pages.title: FAQ
pages.content:
( 07 )

FAQ

Find detailed answers to common questions about our corporate office relocation process, weekend schedule, IT handling, and pricing.

Asked, answered.

FAQ

( 01 )

Before

What is included in the initial site survey?

The site survey and labelled floor plan is completely included in our service. Six weeks before your target move, co-founder Samir Haddad visits both your current and destination offices. Samir measures doorways, corridors, and lifts, evaluates vehicle access, and assesses IT infrastructure. Following this walk-through, Samir creates a detailed destination floor plan with colour zones and desk numbers, allowing us to issue a fixed, binding quotation.

Do our staff pack their own desks?

Yes, employees typically pack their own desk contents, personal effects, and active files. Tom Verbeke delivers reusable plastic crates measuring 60 × 40 × 35 cm ten working days prior to the move, with rental included for three weeks. We allocate an average of six crates per desk along with pre-printed labels and cable bags. Our professional crew packs all common areas, archive rooms, and meeting spaces.

What geographic areas do you cover from your depot?

Isso Relocation was founded in 2014 with headquarters and a central crate depot located at Dokweg 12, 2030 Antwerp, Belgium. We operate within a 150 km radius of Antwerp, regularly serving businesses in Antwerp, Ghent, Brussels, Mechelen, Leuven, and Rotterdam. All relocations within this territory are managed directly by our permanent seven-person team and dedicated fleet.

( 02 )

The weekend

How does the 61-hour weekend move window work?

Our move window runs from Friday 18:00 to Monday 07:00, providing 61 hours of dedicated operational time. On Friday at 18:00, Kwame Mensah and the loading crew begin packing vehicles. By Saturday 07:00, the old floor is cleared. On Sunday, Ana Ribeiro and Joanna Kowalczyk reassemble desks and reconnect IT by 12:00. At 20:00 on Sunday, we conduct a joint walk-through before handing back keys at 07:00 on Monday.

How are computers and workstation IT equipment handled?

Joanna Kowalczyk leads our IT disconnect and reconnect service, priced at €38 per workstation. On Friday evening, our technicians disconnect screens, docking stations, power blocks, and network cables, placing them into dedicated cable bags tagged with the matching desk number. On Sunday, our team mounts monitors on desk arms, routes cabling neatly, and reconnects docks so staff can log in immediately on Monday morning.

What if Monday is a public holiday?

When a relocation falls before a public holiday, we adjust our schedule while maintaining our standard 61-hour allocation. We can execute packing and transit across Friday and Saturday, completing furniture and IT assembly by Sunday evening as usual. Alternatively, we can adapt our schedule so that our dedicated two-person on-site support team is present from 07:00 to 12:00 on Tuesday morning when your staff return to the office.

( 03 )

After

What support is provided on Monday morning?

On Monday morning, two crew members are stationed at your new office from 07:00 to 12:00. They assist arriving employees with crate handling, adjust monitor heights, reconfigure desk positions, and solve any minor physical layout adjustments. This immediate support ensures that staff settle in smoothly without facilities bottlenecks. Tom Verbeke later collects the empty crates within the three-week rental period.

Are moves protected by insurance and permanent staff?

Yes. We never use day labour or temporary agency workers; every move is executed by our permanent, trained staff led by Kwame Mensah and Ana Ribeiro. Comprehensive transit and public liability insurance protects all office furniture, technical equipment, and building premises throughout the move. Our crew installs wall and lift protection at both sites to prevent damage during transit.

( 04 )

Prices

What are your standard relocation package prices?

We offer clear, fixed pricing: moves up to 15 desks start from €3,900; moves of 16 to 40 desks start from €8,600; floor moves of 41 to 90 desks start from €17,500. A site survey and floor plan is included. IT disconnect and reconnect is €38 per workstation, extra reassembly crew is €65 per crew hour, and secure disposal is €140 per locked cage. All prices exclude 21% VAT.

What are your payment and booking terms?

To reserve your preferred weekend slot, a 30% deposit is payable upon booking confirmation following your formal quotation. The remaining balance is payable within 14 days after the relocation has been completed. If your company schedules shift, you may reschedule or cancel your booked move weekend without any fee up until 10 working days before the scheduled Friday move date.

( 05 )

Request a quote

Every move starts with a free survey and ends with a fixed written quote.

Request a quote

pages.title: Privacy
pages.content:
Privacy

Privacy Policy

PRIVACY

Information We Collect

We collect company names, contact names, email addresses, phone numbers, and physical addresses solely to prepare relocation quotations, conduct site surveys, and execute commercial moving contracts. We also process office floor plans, workstation counts, and building access requirements necessary to plan logistics. All information is retained strictly for operational execution, customer support, and statutory accounting purposes under Belgian commercial law.

Data Security and Confidentiality

We do not sell, rent, or distribute client data to external marketing companies. All floor plans, employee seating charts, and building security details provided during move planning are treated with strict confidentiality by our permanent team. To review, correct, or request deletion of your contact data from our records, please contact our data controller at hello@issorelocation.example or write to Dokweg 12, 2030 Antwerp, Belgium.

posts.title: Forty-Two Desks, Two Floors Down: Relocating a Ghent Architecture Studio
posts.excerpt: How an architecture studio in Ghent moved forty-two desks across two floors into a single open-plan workspace between Friday evening and Sunday afternoon.
posts.content:
MOVE 01

Forty-two desks, two floors down

Ghent · 42 desks · Fri 18:00 → Sun 16:40

Fri 18:00 → Sun 16:40

MOVE 01

( 01 )

Before

Survey, labels and crates

When an expanding architecture practice in Ghent secured a single open-plan floor to consolidate their team, the primary operational challenge was protecting client deadlines. Moving forty-two workstations, drafting tables, and reference libraries across two floors down to a single unified level required strict coordination. Relocating during normal office hours was out of the question. Co-founder Samir Haddad visited the studio six weeks prior to the move for a comprehensive site survey, recording architectural layouts, measuring doorways and stairwells, and reviewing lift access at both levels.

Three weeks before the scheduled move date, Samir delivered the detailed floor plan. Every functional team within the studio was assigned an identifiable colour zone, and each architect's desk received an individual destination number. Ten working days prior to moving, Tom Verbeke dispatched reusable grey plastic crates measuring 60 × 40 × 35 cm from our Antwerp depot at Dokweg 12. Each staff member received an average of six crates, allowing the architects to pack their project files, material samples, and personal drafting tools at their own pace over the fortnight leading up to the relocation.

Saturday, 07:00. The old floors are empty and forty-two crate stacks stand in their colour zones.

( 02 )

Friday and Saturday

Lift, load and set out

The physical move began precisely at Friday 18:00. Kwame Mensah and our Saturday loading crew arrived on site to protect the building entrances, line the lift interiors, and roll out protective floor runners. Crate dollies were systematically queued and loaded. By Saturday morning at 07:00, the old two-floor studio was completely emptied, and all forty-two crate stacks were arranged in their designated colour zones on the new floor below. Every cable bag, drafting screen, and storage unit bore its corresponding destination label, allowing the staging team to place each item beside its future desk frame without intermediate staging.

( 03 )

Sunday

Desks built, IT live

On Sunday morning, Ana Ribeiro took over with the reassembly crew, anchoring desk frames and leveling workbenches to exact floor plan alignments. Joanna Kowalczyk led the IT disconnect and reconnect team, methodically setting up monitors, docking stations, and network cabling across every single workstation. Because cables and peripherals had been tagged and bagged by workstation number on Friday evening, each architect's hardware was matched to the correct desk without cross-swapping components.

By Sunday 16:40, well ahead of our standard 61-hour window and hours before our formal 20:00 walk-through, the entire floor was fully functional. Systems were reconnected, crates were staged neatly for unpacking, and floor runners were cleared. Studio manager Hanne De Smet walked the floor for the sign-off inspection. As Hanne noted, seeing every desk assembled with its monitors powered on and labelled crates positioned underneath meant the team could resume drawing on Monday morning without disruption.

( 04 )

Monday

Two crew stay until 12:00

On Monday morning at 07:00, two crew members arrived on site to assist arriving staff, help adjust monitor arms, and relocate a handful of archive boxes. By 12:00, their support window concluded as normal business operations were underway. Tom Verbeke scheduled the collection of empty crates over the following three weeks, completing a calm, seamless transition within our 150 km operating zone.

Every desk was assembled with its monitors on and its crates underneath. Monday morning was just drawing.

Hanne De Smet, studio manager
